jobs.name: home_bg
jobs.prompt: Wide cinematic background illustration, flat vector style with soft painterly gradients, very dark and moody so text can sit on top. Night scene: a cozy little wooden doghouse on a gentle grassy hill in the lower right third, warm golden light glowing from its round door, a big soft golden full moon low in the sky, faint stars, gentle rolling dark hills fading into warm near-black. Palette: deep espresso brown, near-black warm charcoal, muted amber and gold highlights only on the moon, the doorway glow and tiny fireflies. Large calm empty dark sky across the upper two thirds. No text, no characters, no watermark.
